An emergency fund helps cover unexpected expenses like medical bills or car repairs without going into debt. To start, aim to save at least $1,000, then work towards 3-6 months' worth of expenses. Begin by setting a monthly savings goal based on what you can afford, and automate transfers to a savings account.

This is general information, not financial advice.
